text_block_list.text:
Hmm... El and Grass have been in there for
a while now. Do you think
everything is
okay?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Not sure. And the president's been in
device 01 running this whole
time...
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff... puff... Hehe. Hehehaha! Heh...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф?

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is President Rudolf... laughing in
there?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Whaddya mean, they're burning
everything? What's goin' on?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The demon army targeted the village's
food reserves! I wish we could
go back and
save everyone, but we'll never make it in
time!
text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos

text_block_list.text:
No. That may be true of you, or
werewolves, or perhaps even wyverns.

However...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
We're Umamusume! We can cover the
distance. Let's go, El! This is our
"Fantasy
Debut"!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Haaaah!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We're Umamusume, the fastest of all life in
Umanest. In the blink of
an eye, we cross
many miles, until...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
They've come to meddle with our plans?!
Soldiers, slather your arrows
with toxins
and tranquilizers! We're gonna rain terror
upon them!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text: Ugh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Did we get her?! Bwahaha! Just a drop of
that poison could—
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text: What's this?!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
Not only are we fast, but we're also
extremely resilient. Umamusume
can shrug
off basic debuffs like poison and paralysis.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? We'll see how resilient you really are! Keep firing! Give 'em more poison than they can shake!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
Who's spinnin' the ground... Ack, Grass!
Grass?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. Just because you're resistant
doesn't mean you're invincible.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Comforting Heal!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Nice one! Now we're talkin'!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Heh. We'll just fight magic with magic.
Sink their ankles into a mucky
quagmire!
Mudfield!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text: Umamusume Skill—Wet Conditions ◎!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
What?! Argh, you have left me with no
recourse but to cast a
time-reversal spell!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
Reverse! Hands of the clock, turn
backward!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
A time-reversal skill? We don't have
anything to counter that...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
(But Umamusume never give up! If time is
runnin' counterclockwise,
then so will I!)
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: (Umamusume Skill—Left-Handed ◎!)
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: What?! They can go counterclockwise?!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah! Shrieking Condor Wave!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Gyaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
Now apologize! And give back the food
you've stolen!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, hahahaha! What a shame!
My lordship has already
taken all your
food supplies away! It seems you arrived
too late.
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
The demon lord was here?! We must give
chase and capture that
tyrant. No one can
outrun an Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hmph... It is no use. You will never catch
up to the demon lord.
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
For my lordship is no mere man or
beast—but something faster!
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
So give up. I assume you can put two and
two together.
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text:
What could be so fast that even
Umamusume can't catch up? They'd
have
to be faster than a wyvern to start, so that
leaves fenrirs,
thunderdrakes, or...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: No, y-you can't mean...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha. Finally figured it out, huh? Yes,
our new lord of demons is
capable of
running just as fast as you. Because our
lordship is—
text_block_list.name: Demon Army Officer

text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehe... Take thaaaat!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф?

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! The runner in device 01 is talking
again! But that didn't sound
like President
Rudolf...
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Rice grains, in the bag! Now I've got
everything I need to make some
tasty rice
porridge! If Peter Piper picked a peck of
pickled peppers,
then I'll pick a pretty
plenty pound!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Isn't that Golshi?! She's definitely not in
there for a test run. She's just
fooling
around...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Knowing her, she's not just fooling around. She's probably causing the system error herself.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Director, why don't we just kick her out of
there?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hmm. If we fiddle with the machines now,
there's a chance it'd only
make things
worse! So...
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text:
Onwards! We must commit firmly to the
course we've set!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
